taskNotes: The wiki task page is titled Zygomites; Slayer masters refer to the assignment as Mutated zygomites.
Zygomites cannot be killed unless a fungicide spray is used to deliver the final blow.
requiredItemId 7421 is the fully-charged Fungicide spray 10 (wiki item infobox id); partially-used sprays use ids 7422-7430, so an owned check against 7421 can miss a part-used spray.
Regular Zygomites must be picked from Fungi before they can be attacked.
Zygomites mostly use magical melee headbutts and occasionally use stronger magical ranged spore attacks.
Dragonhide armour or Karil's armour is strongly recommended because high Magic defence reduces incoming damage.
Protect from Melee is recommended when praying against regular Zygomites because their melee attacks are more accurate.
Ancient Zygomites use magical melee and magical ranged attacks; their ranged attacks are stronger and more accurate, so Protect from Missiles can be considered for ancient-only trips.
Ancient Zygomites can be safespotted by trapping them and standing at least six tiles away because their ranged attack reaches five tiles.
Ancient Zygomites always drop Mort myre fungus, making a Reagent pouch useful on Ancient Zygomite trips.
Konar location locks matter: a Zanaris task requires regular Zygomites, while a Fossil Island task requires Ancient Zygomites because no regular variants are on Fossil Island.
'Shroom sprayer costs 110 Slayer points and automatically delivers the finishing blow if the player has Fungicide spray and Fungicide.
recommendedMethod: Bring fungicide spray and refills, wear dragonhide or Karil's for magic defence, use Protect from Melee for regular Zygomites, safespot where available, and use Ancient Zygomites with a Reagent pouch when location locks allow.
